In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> during the [[Battle of Anaxes]] of the [[Clone Wars]], a '''battalion''' of [[battle droid]]s served within the [[Separatist Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the engagements on the [[planet]] [[Anaxes]], the [[battalion]], which consisted of [[B1-series battle droid]]s and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid]]s, led by an [[OOM command battle droid]], were attacked by the [[Genetically defective clone|defective]] [[clone commando]]s of [[Clone Force 99]] in a canyon near [[Sector One]], a Separatist control point during the battle. As a result of the attack, Clone Force 99, undertaking a [[Plan 82|devised strategy]], destroyed the entire battalion.<ref name="The Bad Batch" />
